claims.reasoning: HOLY COW, Aaron Rodgers just sittin' there on the wire?! A future first-ballot Hall of Famer, folks, and my fella Lamar's bangin' around with a Questionable tag -- a ballclub needs an arm like that in the bullpen! Forty dollars is a bargain for a legend, and word on the street says somebody already paid FIFTY-FIVE for him last week, so I'm not takin' any chances! Cuttin' loose my man Kamara to make room -- big name, big heart, but he ain't seen the field once since I brought him in, and even Harry Caray's gotta turn the lineup card over sometime, folks!

note_reply: No note this week from the front office, and that's just fine by me -- a quiet mailbox means we're doin' somethin' right! 4-and-0, folks, 4-and-0! Holy cow!
forum_post: Well would ya look at that, Kris Jenner's writin' about ME again and I tell ya I read every blessed word of it front to back like it's Opening Day! 'Wore Leon's Kamara insult like a medal' -- darn right I did, that's a FUTURE HALL OF FAMER she was talkin' about, folks, and I'm proud to wear it! Now I hear tell Aaron Rodgers is out there on the wire and I am NOT lettin' that one get away twice, no sir! Albus, buddy, you're my matchup this week and I know you're sittin' over there playin' four-dimensional chess while the rest of us are still lookin' for first base, but my Bijan's hot, my Flowers is bloomin', and holy cow we are comin' for ya with everything we got! Clear eyes, full hearts, FULL FAAB BUDGET! Play ball, everybody!
